bank.no_accounts: No bank accounts yet. Add one to import its transactions.
bank.delete_account_confirm: Delete the account %s and its %d transactions?
bank.import_hint: The file is read first and shown, so you can check it before anything is imported. Rows imported before are skipped.
bank.imported: Imported %d new transactions; %s were imported before.
bank.undo_confirm: Undo this import and delete its %d transactions?
bank.err_csv: The file could not be read as CSV.
bank.err_columns: Too few columns for this bank format.
bank.err_date: Not a date in this bank format:
bank.err_amount: Not an amount in this bank format:
bank.delete_transaction_confirm: Delete %s (%s)? It comes back if a file with it is imported again.
plugin.bank.about: Bank accounts per budget, with transactions imported from the bank's CSV export and assigned to budget lines by rules.
bank.unassigned_count: %d transactions in %d are not assigned to a budget line.
bank.no_budget_year: The budget has no year %d, so its transactions cannot be assigned to lines yet.
bank.remember_hint: Make a rule from the text, so transactions like it are assigned the same way
bank.by_rule_hint: Assigned by a rule. Changing it here assigns it by hand.
bank.assign_hint: Ignored transactions are not counted in the budget, e.g. transfers between your own accounts. With Remember ticked, a rule is made from the text without dates and used for the transactions not yet assigned.
bank.rules_hint: A rule assigns every transaction whose text contains the rule's text, in any case. When several rules fit, the most specific wins. Rules only assign transactions that are not assigned; those assigned by hand are left alone.
bank.rule_new: New rule, e.g. a loan number
bank.rule_delete_confirm: Delete the rule %s? The %d transactions it assigned become unassigned.
bank.no_rules: No rules yet. They are made when you assign transactions with Remember ticked, or here.
bank.rule_err_duplicate: Two rules cannot have the same text.
bank.rule_err_target: Choose a budget line for the new rule.
bank.rule_err_empty: A rule needs some text besides *.
bank.rules_tip_contains: The rule's text only has to be part of the transaction's text, in any case: pharmacy matches "Pharmacy Main Street 12" and "PHARMACY STATION".
bank.rules_tip_star: * stands for any text: pharmacy*street matches "Pharmacy Main Street 12" and "Pharmacy High Street", but not "Pharmacy Station".
bank.rules_tip_keep: Keep only the part that stays the same: pharmacy instead of "Card purchase Pharmacy Main Street 12".
bank.compare_no_year: The budget has no years yet.
bank.compare_unassigned: %d transactions in the period, %s in all, are not assigned to a line and not counted.
bank.compare_hint: Actual is the sum of the transactions assigned to the line in the period; ignored ones are left out. The difference is green where the line did better than budgeted: less spent, or more earned.
bank.compared_none: No months to compare: no transactions are imported for this year.
bank.fill: Fill the budget from the bank…
bank.fill_kept: %d amounts set by hand are kept. Choose Overwrite amounts to replace them too.
bank.fill_hint: Each amount is saved like an edit on the budget page, with history, so it can be restored under Manage.
bank.fill_nothing: Nothing to fill: the budget already has these amounts.
bank.fill_untouched: Lines without transactions in a month, and linked lines, are not changed.
